data.evidence: sampled native evaluated output under two private control overrides; no project mutation
data.limitation: detects exact changes in bounded geometry/paint or uniform field evidence; does not establish the intended magnitude, readability or pixel visibility. Truncated, varying-field and effect evidence is inconclusive; use displacement/direction and rendered comparisons for intended response.

variants.bounds_kind: analytic outline/point bounds in the reported coordinate space; excludes stroke, effects, masks and clipping
variants.evidence: evaluated geometry; visibility includes effects, masks and clipping only in rendered images
variants.space: node output coordinates; depends on upstream construction
